question.problem: Expressed as a fraction in its simplest form, ${log}_{16}⁡(64)$ equals{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
We use the change of base formula:

$$
{log}_{a}⁡X=\frac{{log}_{b}⁡X}{{log}_{b}⁡a}
$$

In our case, $a=16$ and $X=64.$ Since both $a$ and $X$ are powers of $2,$ we set $b=2.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{16}⁡(64) & =\frac{{log}_{2}⁡(64)}{{log}_{2}⁡(16)} \\  & =\frac{{log}_{2}⁡({2}^{6})}{{log}_{2}⁡({2}^{4})} \\  & =\frac{6}{4} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
